description: Get comprehensive statistics for a French department. Returns total associations, active count, top cities, sector breakdown, and temporal evolution. Use department codes: 01-95 for metropolitan France, 2A/2B for Corsica, 971-976 for overseas.

code.description: Department code (e.g., "69" for Rhône, "75" for Paris, "2A" for Corse-du-Sud)
